data.body:
Fixed and merged in Gerrit change 2922 (commit c8af0eb82f265 on Gerrit main).

RCA: `check_wall_clock_asserts` only detected direct upper-bound elapsed-time assertions, so it missed byte/text equality between independently emitted artifacts that can embed wall-clock timestamps. The motivating flaky test compared two saved BindingStore JSON files whose `created_at`/`updated_at` bytes came from separate `_now_iso` calls.

Disposition: implemented a conservative AST proxy for unfrozen cross-artifact `read_bytes()`/`read_text()` equality/inequality, including variable-mediated comparisons. Same-receiver direct and variable-vs-direct re-reads are exempt, `_now_iso`/`utc_now_iso` freezes are exempt, and reviewed timestamp-free comparisons use reason-required `# timing: artifact-equality — ...` markers.

Evidence: RED tests initially failed for direct and variable cross-receiver comparisons; focused `pytest tests/unit/test_wall_clock_assert_lint.py -q` passed (21 tests); `python scripts/check_wall_clock_asserts.py .` passed clean; `make lint` passed with complexity/mechanism ratchets clean; full `make verify` passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset; Gerrit 2922 received LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and was submitted.
